run_hydra_app: run a Hydra app with config overrides and task function using _run_hydra
locate_object_by_path: locate a Python object by dotted path string using _locate
get_args_parser: get the Hydra argument parser with all CLI flags using get_args_parser
detect_calling_file_or_module: detect the calling file or module from a task function using detect_calling_file_or_module_from_task_function
create_config_search_path: create an automatic config search path with hydra and main entries using create_config_search_path
